resolved_findings.claim: The residual component gauge theory has a complete minimal BV cotangent theory.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: No component ghost-antifield ledger or component master action had been defined.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Define every component field, antifield, ghost number, parity, odd pairing, BRST rule, and direct CME calculation.

resolved_findings.claim: Q is a degree-one differential after the holomorphic twist.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: The U(1)_R charges and antifield regrading were absent.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Derive the pure-action R symmetry, derive r(Q) from the component rules, and define deg_HT=gh_BV-r.

resolved_findings.claim: The full twisted BV space is directly symplectomorphic to holomorphic BF.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: The claimed spaces have different dimensions.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Replace the false statement by an exact canonical product with T*[-1]V_ctr, then display a cyclic strong deformation retract.

resolved_findings.claim: delta=s+Q is square-zero on the complete field algebra.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: Qc and the anticommutator sQ+Qs had not been fixed.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Set Qc=0 and expand the covariant-field and connection anticommutators separately.

resolved_findings.claim: The Euclidean action can be removed by a BV canonical transform.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: No exact Q-primitive with all bosonic, fermionic, and topological terms had been shown.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Expand QPsi_0, prove the six-curvature polynomial identity, expand the fermion kinetic term, and eliminate integral P only under the declared compact-support scope.

resolved_findings.claim: Deleting Q-doublets preserves the BV odd symplectic structure.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: A field-only deletion is not canonical and raw antifields cannot be reused after a derivative-dependent field map.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Use an exact cotangent shift, an unweighted super-Darboux potential, and the complete derivative-dependent cotangent lift with every Frechet-transpose antifield row displayed.

resolved_findings.claim: The horizontal master action equals standard holomorphic BF with fixed normalization.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: The volume factor, one-quarter antifield coefficients, and transformed origin of B were absent.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Use Omega wedge barOmega=-4d4x and expand all three antiholomorphic-degree products.

resolved_findings.claim: The reduced action satisfies the classical master equation.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: The base-field squares, antifield Hamiltonian vector field, and antifield squares had not all been expanded.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Differentiate the horizontal action with respect to all eight coordinates and expand every field and antifield square through covariant-derivative and graded-Jacobi cancellation.

resolved_findings.claim: The vertical cotangent factor can be projected out as an acyclic sector.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: No homotopy or cotangent-dual cyclicity check was supplied.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Give h eta_i=u_i and hK=w, display the six dual differential and homotopy entries with signs, and verify delta h+h delta=1-ip and cyclicity on all twelve coordinates.

resolved_findings.claim: The self-contained parent supersymmetry rule and the six-pair component calculation have the same normalization.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: An extra factor two was initially placed in front of a full antisymmetric Einstein sum.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Use one full mn sum with coefficient minus one, equivalently six independent m<n terms with coefficient minus two, and verify both constructions agree.

resolved_findings.claim: The dotted gaugino and its antifield are dual coordinates in the displayed cotangent map.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: Upper dotted components were used in the Q-rules while lower dotted components were listed as BV coordinates.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Choose tilde-lambda upper-dot-a as the independent coordinate, choose the lower-dotted antifield as its dual, and recompute both eta transpose entries.

resolved_findings.claim: The nonlinear field map is lifted to the complete BV cotangent complex.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: The c-star, A-bar-star, u-star, and w-star rows and their integration-by-parts signs were not displayed.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Expand d eta, dZ, and dK, show the compact-support and invariant-pairing transposes, list every nontrivial antifield row, and contract the one-form equality with delta coefficient by coefficient.

resolved_findings.claim: The Chern-Weil identity is proved using only the defined invariant bilinear pairing.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: An ill-typed fourfold trace expression was used for the quartic term.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Use graded Jacobi to prove A times (A times A)=0 and invariant pairing to obtain pairing(A times A,A times A)=0.

resolved_findings.claim: The full hBF Hamiltonian vector field is square-zero.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: Only the four base-field squares were displayed.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Display delta B, delta A-bar-star, and delta c-star, then expand all four antifield squares including the curvature commutator and mixed Jacobi identity.

resolved_findings.claim: The gauge-covariant closure vector agrees with the displayed commutator order.
resolved_findings.missing_step_before_repair: The sign of v for [delta-epsilon,delta-bar-epsilon] was reversed.
resolved_findings.minimal_repair: Set v=-2 epsilon sigma_E bar-epsilon for the fixed order.

open_findings.claim_not_made: The unconstrained Step-3D superfield BV theory canonically reduces to the residual component BV theory used here.
open_findings.missing_step: The supergauge Wess-Zumino reduction, superghost doublets, and their cotangent lift are not constructed.
open_findings.minimal_repair: Add a separate contract deriving the residual component BV complex from the Step-3D superfield BV complex.

open_findings.claim_not_made: The topological functional vanishes on nontrivial bundles, instanton sectors, manifolds with boundary, or non-compact-support fields.
open_findings.missing_step: Global bundle and boundary data are outside the declared ordinary-space sector.
open_findings.minimal_repair: Retain (g^-2-ik) integral P and specify the global integration sector and boundary action.

open_findings.claim_not_made: Holomorphic twist commutes with quantum BV quantization.
open_findings.missing_step: No regulator, BV density, quantum master action, or anomaly obstruction has been selected.
open_findings.minimal_repair: Construct the regulated QME and calculate the obstruction to the canonical reduction.

spot_checks.calculation: All six independent F_mn coefficients were multiplied through sigma_E^{mn}; the residual against 4F_bar1bar2 is zero.
The curvature polynomial, auxiliary square, fermion derivative decomposition, and topological density were independently expanded; every residual coefficient is zero.
Omega wedge barOmega=-4d4x and every one-quarter coefficient in B were multiplied explicitly; the four odd-pairing coefficients and five action coefficients match the component BV Hamiltonian.
All eleven independent scalar, derivative-transpose, and Lie-transpose coefficients were checked against the explicit old-to-final antifield rows.
The base and antifield squares were independently expanded; connection-antifield derivative terms, the curvature commutator, and the mixed c-alpha-B Jacobi coefficients all vanish exactly.
